<center>
#__[365 Days Anime Challenge](https://anilist.co/forum/thread/85412)__
Will be curious to compare this to my 100 day anime and manga challenge answers
<hr>
#__Day 235: Series that would make for a good video game__
Okay so I've literally only ever watched a single episode of it, but I did think that it would work much better as a video game than an anime, just based on that first episode. The plot and everything felt very much like some JRPG thing.
https://anilist.co/anime/20800

Aside from that hmmmmm, the action of the Fate series is perfect for RPGs, but there's already some of those (Samurai Remnant, Extra)

An action-rhythm game of FLCL could potentially be alright too, but I don't actually think that would work too well.........

So final answer is, Yuki Yuna but only based on one episode i watched years ago
<hr>
